title: Phase separation of the PRPP amidotransferase into dynamic condensates promotes de novo purine synthesis in yeast.
authors: Takaine, Masak; Morita, Rikuri; Yoshinari, Yuto; Nishimura, Takashi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酵母中PRPP酰胺转移酶通过相分离形成凝聚体调控嘌呤从头合成，虽涉及分子动力学模拟，但核心是酶代谢调控而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: De novo purine synthesis (DPS) is up-regulated under conditions of high purine demand to ensure the production of genetic materials and chemical energy, thereby supporting cell proliferation. However, the regulatory mechanisms governing DPS remain unclear. We herein show that PRPP amidotransferase (PPAT), the rate-limiting enzyme in DPS, forms dynamic and motile condensates in Saccharomyces cerevisiae cells under a purine-depleted environment. The formation and maintenance of condensates requires phase separation, which is driven by target of rapamycin complex 1 (TORC1)-induced ribosome biosynthesis. The self-assembly of PPAT molecules facilitates condensate formation, with intracellular PRPP and purine nucleotides both regulating this self-assembly. Moreover, molecular dynamics simulations suggest that clustering-mediated PPAT activation occurs through intermolecular substrate channeling. Cells unable to form PPAT condensates exhibit growth defects, highlighting the physiological importance of condensation. These results indicate that PPAT condensation is an adaptive mechanism that regulates DPS in response to both TORC1 activity and cellular purine demands.
abstract_zh: 从头嘌呤合成（de novo purine synthesis, DPS）在高嘌呤需求条件下上调，以确保遗传物质和化学能的产生，从而支持细胞增殖。然而，调控DPS的机制仍不清楚。我们在此表明，在嘌呤耗竭环境下，酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）细胞中，DPS的限速酶PRPP酰胺转移酶（PPAT）形成动态且可移动的凝聚体。凝聚体的形成和维持需要相分离（phase separation），该过程由雷帕霉素靶蛋白复合物1（TORC1）诱导的核糖体生物合成驱动。PPAT分子的自组装促进凝聚体形成，而细胞内PRPP和嘌呤核苷酸均调控此自组装。此外，分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟表明，聚类介导的PPAT激活通过分子间底物通道实现。无法形成PPAT凝聚体的细胞表现出生长缺陷，凸显了凝聚的生理重要性。这些结果表明，PPAT凝聚是一种适应性机制，响应TORC1活性和细胞嘌呤需求来调控DPS。
